target.purpose: Apply typed object diffs against exact known state through fail-closed transactional writeback with explicit sign-off, rollback, reverse diffs, and deterministic receipts.
target.central_bottleneck: Consequential object mutations become unsafe when schema/base state, attempt identity, sign-off, transaction ancestry, rollback, or receipt truth can drift independently.

invariants: schema fingerprint must match the required schema
current object state must match the caller-bound base snapshot
writeback parent must match the current ledger tip
structurally valid diff ids are one-shot attempt identities
configured sign-off policy must pass before mutation
failed batches restore every object mutation and preserve refusal evidence
undo is an explicit reverse diff rather than silent state rewind
nonclaims: no Palantir affiliation or proprietary access
